OL 9 must mount /tmp with the nodev option.
The .NET CLR must be configured to use FIPS approved encryption modules.
.Net applications that invoke NetFx40_LegacySecurityPolicy must apply previous versions of .NET STIG guidance.
.NET default proxy settings must be reviewed and approved.
Passwords for enabled local Administrator accounts must be changed at least every 60 days.
Passwords for enabled local Administrator accounts must be changed at least every 60 days.
The built-in guest account must be disabled.
Java software installed on a production IIS 10.0 web server must be limited to .class files and the Java Virtual Machine.
Software certificate installation files must be removed from Windows 10.
Software certificate installation files must be removed from Windows 11.

The application pools rapid fail protection settings for each IIS 10.0 website must be managed.
The application pools rapid fail protection settings for each IIS 8.5 website must be managed.
Auditing of Backup and Restore Privileges must be turned off.
Auditing of Backup and Restore Privileges must be turned off.

NGINX must accept Personal Identity Verification (PIV) credentials.

IIS 10.0 web server system files must conform to minimum file permission requirements.
The IIS 10.0 website must produce log records that contain sufficient information to establish the outcome (success or failure) of IIS 10.0 website events.
The IIS 10.0 website must produce log records containing sufficient information to establish the identity of any user/subject or process associated with an event.
Backup interactive scripts on the IIS 10.0 server must be removed.
The IIS 8.5 website must produce log records that contain sufficient information to establish the outcome (success or failure) of IIS 8.5 website events.
The IIS 8.5 website must produce log records containing sufficient information to establish the identity of any user/subject or process associated with an event.
Backup interactive scripts on the IIS 8.5 server must be removed.
